business_summary: Aidma Holdings, Inc. engages in the sales and business support services in Japan. The company's sales support tools include Sales Platform, a sales tools and consulting services; Sales Crowd, a cloud-based sales tool with functions for sales activities; Sales unit, that provides one-stop support; Online Sales Consulting; meet in, an online video communication tool; Crowd Calendar, an online scheduling tool; Urikata, a survey tool that allows to self-check the qualities of a salesperson; Online Sales Lab, an information platform; BIZMAPS, a corporate data platform; Sales School which monitors and analyzes salespeople; Nokosel, a tool that analyze customer interests; and Marketing Media, an advertising medium. Its business support tools include Crowd Members, an organizational building and management support service utilizing remote workers; secretary, AI, CS, HR, management outsourcing, back office support, and system development support unit; mama works, a support site for housewives; ReWorks, a job placement service; CXO works, a job site offering part-time work opportunities; MEMBER-S, a task and production management tool; Curapro, a service that allows the creation of sales content; IPO support; and cuepid, a site that matches influencers with companies. In addition, the company provides Keypersons, a matching platform for payers; COLABO, a business matching app; CXO bank, a direct networking service for business owners; Venture CXO Summit, a CXO networking event; GOMAPS, an M and A platform that solves business successions problems; M&A intermediary service, a service that connects companies seeking business succession with M and A brokerage firms; and Media Unit, a service to help expand brand awareness. Further, it offers Crowd Unit, an approach to replace traditional recruitment. The company was incorporated in 2008 and is headquartered in Shinagawa, Japan.
